description: Cryptographic implementations use deprecated algorithms, insufficient key lengths, or insecure configurations. This signal indicates that encryption may not provide adequate protection against modern cryptographic attacks.
applicability: Applicable to any cryptographic implementation including TLS/SSL configurations, encryption algorithms, key management, and certificate handling. Includes both data encryption and communication encryption.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through TLS configuration scanning, cipher suite analysis, certificate validation, and cryptographic library version review. May involve tools like SSL Labs, testssl.sh, or cryptographic audit tools.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
